outcome: A contact list exported from a spreadsheet imports without the user editing the file first.

acceptance_criteria.text: Rows with valid addresses import and rows with invalid ones are reported with their line numbers.

expected_verification.assertion: an invalid address is reported as rejected with its line number

acceptance_criteria.text: A header row is recognised and skipped rather than reported as an invalid address.

expected_verification.assertion: a file whose first line is a header imports its data rows and rejects nothing

data_impact: Imported contacts are inserted; rejected rows are not.
